    - CALCULATIONS: 
        MIN_DOWN = PROP_VALUE * 0.15
        MONTHLY_RATE = INTEREST_RATE / 1200
        MONTHLY_PAYMENT = LOAN_AMOUNT * monthly_rate / (1 - (1 + monthly_rate)**(-term_months))
        Use ROUNDED for all financial computations.

               WS-INTEREST DELIMITED BY SIZE
               " " DELIMITED BY SIZE
               WS-PRINCIPAL DELIMITED BY SIZE
               " " DELIMITED BY SIZE
               WS-REMAIN-BAL DELIMITED BY SIZE
               INTO OUT-REC
        END-STRING
        WRITE OUT-REC
    END-PERFORM.
